scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/bundle-preload.js && npm run build:tauri-bridge
scripts.tauri:build: npm run build && npm run fetch-node && npm run fetch-npm && npm run tauri:staging && node scripts/prepare-tauri-config.mjs --release && npx tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.generated.conf.json --bundles nsis
scripts.tauri:build:linux: npm run build && npm run fetch-node && npm run fetch-npm && npm run tauri:staging && node scripts/prepare-tauri-config.mjs --release && npx tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.generated.conf.json --bundles deb,rpm && scripts/build-tauri-pacman.sh && scripts/build-tauri-appimage.sh
scripts.predist: npm run build && node scripts/check-syntax.js && node scripts/build-native.js copy
scripts.prepack: npm run build && node scripts/check-syntax.js && node scripts/build-native.js copy
scripts.dist: node scripts/patch-portable-template.js && node scripts/patch-deps.js && electron-builder --win && node scripts/make-release-hashes.js
scripts.dist:linux: npm run predist && node scripts/patch-deps.js && electron-builder --linux --x64
scripts.dist:arch: npm run predist && node scripts/patch-deps.js && electron-builder --linux pacman --x64
scripts.dist:deb: npm run predist && node scripts/patch-deps.js && electron-builder --linux deb --x64
scripts.dist:rpm: npm run predist && node scripts/patch-deps.js && electron-builder --linux rpm --x64
scripts.dist:appimage: npm run predist && node scripts/patch-deps.js && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64
scripts.postinstall: npm run build && node scripts/patch-deps.js || exit 0
scripts.fetch-runtime: npm run build && node scripts/fetch-node.js && node scripts/fetch-npm.js
